title: Family, on the Page
label: ch:bn-family-on-the-page
canDo: I can read পরিবার and ভাই, and say why the i at the end of ভাই takes its full letter even though it is nowhere near the start of the word.

payoff.summary: Brother read as three pieces, with the independent-vowel rule doing work in an unexpected place — nothing to lean on turns out to mean what it says, not start of word.
